scope_reference_evidence.text_excerpt: This attributional method covers complete manufacture of a new uncoated single-level solid-pine bed-frame kit from actual received untreated kiln-dried sawn/planed stock through selection, cutting, remaining planing, mortise/tenon and hole machining, dry sanding, actual approved permanent-subassembly joint bonding if present, fitting/sample assembly, complete hardware/instruction preparation, whole-configuration checks and unique first quality release. The terminal is one complete unassembled flat-pack kit across all parcels, with headboard/foot-end/side members, all actual slat battens and solid-pine slats, drawing-specific centre supports and all supplied functional articles. Customer assembly and the mattress are outside this terminal. Sources: `glb-untreated-london`; `glb-component-machining`; `glb-hardware-kit`; `glb-kit-delivery`; `glb-solid-slats`; `cashmores-kd-pine`.

The primary evidence is a transparent technical synthesis. The bed manufacturer establishes whole untreated-pine beds, actual component preparation, mortise/tenon/slat fastening and full kit supply. The timber merchant independently establishes a real kiln-dried untreated planed supply form; the adhesive TDS only supports an actually qualified optional permanent joint, not a claimed recipe for the illustrated bed. No common contemporary order, factory dataset or supplier chain is asserted. Keep the entire approved BOM and instructions; sample-fit and specification-specific tests establish completeness and acceptance without a prescribed numerical load, formaldehyde threshold or certification.

Exclude purchased-finished-bed repacking, loose legs/rails/slat bases alone, mattresses/box springs, upholstery, MDF/particleboard/plywood or laminated/finger-jointed principal structures, hardwood principal frames, bentwood/steam bending, onsite log conversion/sawmill/kiln, coated/oiled/waxed/preserved routes, reactive/2K joint glue, electrical/adjustable/folding/storage/loft/bunk/child/medical beds and customer assembly/use/end of life. Actual original-cohort packing/storage/handling/dispatch/returns remain separate incremental services over the observed factory-gate horizon. Actual different principal routes require fresh applicability assessment; every actual in-route ancillary atom is added rather than hidden as zero/other.

en_description.text_excerpt: One complete new single-level non-powered unassembled bed-frame kit: all actual headboard members/posts, foot-end members/posts, both long side rails and slat-support battens, the full solid-pine slat system, configuration-specific centre beam/support legs if specified, all actual joint hardware and included instructions/accessories/tools. All parcels together form the same kit. No mattress, bare rail, sole mattress-support base, loose leg or purchased-finished-bed repacking qualifies. Native Product is manufactured finished wooden bedroom furniture, production mix at plant, Mass reference; the broad physically compatible family is narrowed here to this entire untreated kit. Its general comment includes an adjacent jewellery heading, which is not a material/route/type restriction on the consistent furniture identity. Qualify species, dimensions, joints, assembly fit, structural/stability/surface tests and actual disposition without a universal test threshold. First quality release requires complete BOM and configuration verification; count no duplicate sample assembly, delivery, return or retest as new production. Q is measured net mass of every complete same-configuration kit first released once, including installed/loose supplied functional hardware and physical instructions but excluding all transport packaging; retain wood moisture. No catalogue mass, secondary property or density is a mass measurement.

findings.summary: The defined exhaustive P/I/ER receipt partition omits a first standalone non-purchased packaging article.
findings.counterexample: Opening stock=0. Receive a first standalone gift/borrow/pool whole packaging article compatible with this actual pool (20 kg measured wet lot), with no paid-goods acquisition, no supplier-accompanied material and no earlier outward event. Retain all 20 kg at closing; no additions/removals, shipment or waste. Old P=I=ER=0 gives left side 0, right side 20 kg. It cannot be invented as an old return or repaired by a moisture/repair residual.
findings.expected_repair: Make actual paid whole-article receipts P (including proven bundled paid goods); make I a disjoint actual first non-purchased receipt, explicitly including borrowed/gift/pool and supplier-included cases that are not P; ER needs the same article earlier outward history. Update headings/cards/protocol fields and normative rules in both languages. Preserve full gross mass, wet stocks, original cohort/H, inherited service and one actual burden owner; no fresh manufacture burden solely because ownership changes.
